adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh-token network request (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)`) and a subsequent `prisma.credential.update(...)` immediately after `const credentialKey = ...` and before returning `new jsforce.Connection(...)`. There is no expiry/need check in the shown code path, so every time this connection-creation logic runs it will perform the refresh call + DB write, which can create extra Salesforce API traffic and DB churn and makes operations more sensitive to transient refresh failures. The claim about jsforce's prior lazy-refresh behavior isn't verifiable from this diff, but the new unconditional behavior is.
